sku mnye dang kha zas bzang du bsten/ 'bebs kyi 'khrul 'khor dang*/ ha 'phrab dang*/ rlung phyir 'don pa mang du byas pas sel bar 'gyur ro// spyir gegs bsal ba dang*/ gegs chung ngu la sel byed kyang zhi ba dang*/ bar pa la bar pa dang*/ chen po la shugs drag po rnams gal che/ de las bzlog na chung ngu chen por 'gyur ba dang*/ chen po bcos dka' ba rnams su 'gyur ro// nyin dang nyin la ye shes kyi nyams phebs par 'gyur na de nyid byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gegs phal cher sel bar 'gyur la/ gzhan du gegs sel gyi gdams ngag la yang mkhas pa dang*/ lus sbyongs la brtson par byed dgos te/ de dag gi yi ge logs su yod pa ltar nyams myong can gyi lag khrid dang bcas te shes par bya'o// gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god (186)pa la/ srog rtsol gyi mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgoms tshul gyi yan lag /bsgom pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/ rgya gar gyi skad du/ pra ṇa ces bsrog /ā ya ma ces pa 'gog pa'am/ rtsol ba'am/ ring du byed pa la 'jug pas/ de mtshams sbyar bas/ pra ṇā ya ma ni srog rtsol lam/ srog 'gog pa ces bya'o// de la srog ni rlung gi ming yin la/ de 'gog pa'am rtsol ba ni 'jug par byed pa'i don no// gnyis pa la srog rtsol gyi yan lag dngos ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga pa rgyud la skyes nas bsgom pa yin la/ rjes mthun pa ni las dang po pas kyang bsgom du rung zhing*/ khyad par du yang thog mar dge ba'i sor bsam gang rigs la nyams myong cung zad red nas bsgom nas shin tu legs so// gsum pa bsgom tshul gyi yan lag la don tshan lnga'i dang po srog rtsol gang la bya ba'i yul ni/ spyir rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le mtha' dag yin la/ de'i gtso bo lte ba yan chad na ro rkyang dbu ma gsum/ lte ba'i 'og tu bshang gci khu ba'i rtsa gsum ste drug

/rlung srog dang thur sel gnyis rnams te/ spro na skabs 'dir rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas tshul rgyas par bshad na legs so// don tshan gnyis pa srog rtsol bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ rgyud las/ de phyir lus kyi don gyi rgyud ni/ nyin zhag so so'i dus su rtsa'i sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ zhes dang*/ dus zhabs pa'i man ngag las kyang*// mi 'gyur bde ba skye ba'i phyir// srog rtsol yan lag bsgom par bya// zhes pa ltar 'gyur med bde ba rgyu tshogs kyi phyogs gcig stong gzugs phyag chen yin pa sor bsam gyi dus nas kyang bsgrubs pa yin la/ phyogs gcig shos rlung las rnam par rgyal ba thob cing*/ a wa dhū tīr bcings pas rdo rje'i lus rnam par dag pa gyur nas (187)'chi ba med pa dang*/ thig le la dbang 'byor par byed pa ni srog rtsol gyi dgos pa'o// don tshan gsum pa srog rtsol du sa ji tsam gyi bar du sgom pa ni/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshe rlung rnams dbu ma 'ba' zhig nas 'bab par 'gyur gyi bar du ste/ des byang chub kyi sems rags pa bzung bzlog la dbang thob par 'gyur zhing*/ dbang po rnon pos zla ba drug gis de 'grub pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rgyud las/ zla ba drug gis sdom brtson rnams la reg byas dman pa'i bde ba mnyam pa lam gyi sems su 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ don tshan bzhi pa srog rtsol gyi ngo bo ni/ srog rtsol dag kyang lam ni gnyis po bsgyel zhing dbu mar srog ni rab tu zhugs pa dag tu 'gyur/ zhes gsungs te/ ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar dgag cing 'og tu bshang gci'i rtsar rgyu ba'i rlung yang dung can mar dgag pa yin la/ de bzhin du dbu mar rgyu ba'i srog dang*/ dung can mar rgyu ba'i thur sel yang gcig tu bsdu bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// don tshan lnga pa srog rtsol ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rgyud las/

zla ba nyi mas a sogs ka sogs rnams kyi rnam gsum bgrod gnas sku yi rdo rje sogs bzlas pa/ zhes pas bstan cing*/ 'jam rlung gang gtong gi dbugs yo ba bsrang ba ni/ ji skad du/ mchan khung g.yas dang g.yas min dag las nu ma dag kyang stobs ldan mnan te srog ni bkag pa las/ g.yas nas g.yon pa'i rtsar ni 'phral la rab 'bab g.yon pa'i mchan khung las kyang g.yas su'o// zla ba phyed kyis kyang ni 'chi ster 'chi ltas 'phrog ste rnal 'byor ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis so// zhes pas bstan/ dgang ba dang bum pa can ni/ kha yang btsum ste sna yi bu ga gnyis po dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung ni ma lus pa/ srog gi shugs kyis bkug ste dri ma med pa'i (188)glog dang mtshungs par thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas te/ zhes pas bstan cing*/ de'i phan yon yang*/ lus la zas la sogs pa dang ni bkres dang skom pa 'phrog cing 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ste/ zhes so// gzhan yang dri med 'od las/ dbyung ba dang dgang ba dang*/ bum pa can gyi sbyor bas ni rtag tu bsnyen pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ srog rtsol gyi man ngag tha dad pa thams cad kyang bstan pa yin no// 'dir bum pa can gtso bo yin pas nges par dgos la/ gzhan dag ni ji ltar rigs par yang sbyar ro// gnas skabs su srog gegs mi 'byung ba'i don du/ rlung stobs rgyas pa dbu mar 'dzud pa'am/ gegs sel gzhan yang rung ste/ de'i dus bstan pa ni/ srog rtsol rab tu bya ste snying kha de bzhin mgo bo dag ni ji srid me yis gdung gyur pa/ zhes pa sogs pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ srog rtsol gyi rtags thams cad g.yas g.yon gyi rlung bcu dbu mar 'gags pa'i mthu las byung ba'i lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams/ mthong nyams/ rmi nyams te rnams pa lngar 'dus pa yin no// tshad ma ni// rnam rtog gi rgyu rlung rnams dbu mar 'gags pa'i ye shes yin pas yid kyi mngon sum gtso bor gyur pa'i mngon sum bzhi'o// lnga pa ni/

dag bya la dbye na 'du shes sogs phung khams drug tshan gcig yod la/ dag byed srog rtsol nyid la dbye na/ g.yas g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu dbu mar 'dres pa'i dbye bas bcu'o// drug pa las/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ srog rtsol gyis ni dag pa ri bong can dang nyi ma rnams bral byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ ro rkyang du rgyu ba'i rlung yon po 'gags pa'i phan yon las/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis lung ston cing byin gyis rlobs/ ye shes kyis snang (189)bar gyur pa'i gzugs sogs yul drug gi 'dod yon la spyod// dbang po drug gi mngon shes skye/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dbang du 'du ba yin la/ mthar thugs gi 'bras bu ni/ don yod grub pa sogs lha rlung khams pa drug tshan gcig thob par 'gyur pa yin no// sgom don blo la 'god pa 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o// des srog rtsol gyi 'khrid tshar ro// gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i 'khrid ston par byed pa la/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ sgom don blo la 'god pa'o// dang po la 'dzin pa'i man ngag dngos dang*/ bogs 'don spogs pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni// gang du ji skad bstan pa ltar/ bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog dbu ma'i thig le la thim par byed pa yin te/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi bum can ni bum pa can tsam du 'dra yang srog rtsol gyi bum can ni/ ro rkyang gi lam dgag pa dang*/ srog thur 'dre ba'i phyir sgom pa yin la/ 'dir ni srog thur 'dres zin pa'i rlung de nyid dbu ma'i thig ler thim par byed pa'i don yin no// de la lte ba'i bum can ni sngar dang 'dra ste/ 'on kyang 'dzin pa'i rjes mthun pa bsgom pa'i skabs 'dir rlung rnams lte ba'i thig le la thim pa'i mos pa tsam yang yang byed pa ni khyad par ro// dmigs bskor nyer drug pa'o// de bzhin du snying kha'i bum can yang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/

lte ba'i bum can bcas zin 'tshams nas snying khar 'dren pa dang*/ lag pa gnyis rgyab tu bsnol/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gi mthe bong g.yas g.yon nas 'then pa'i lus gnad sbrags te bya'o// dmigs bskor nyer bdun pa'o// mgrin pa'i bum can ni/ rkang pa skyil krung bcas te/ pus mo'i nang khugs su gru mo btsugs/ sor mo bsnol bas ltag pa nas mnan te mgo bsgyur/ rlung kha nas rngubs te/ ltag pa'i thad kar thugs bsgyil la lkog mas ol mdud mnan/ (190)thur sel mgrin pa'i thad kar phul lo// dmigs bskor nyer brgyad pa'o// dpral ba'i bum can ni/ phal cher de dang 'dra ba la lag pa gnyis sngar bzhin las spyi bo nas 'then/ rlung yang kha nas rngubs pa rkan gyi phugs su yar bsgyil ba ni khyad par ro// dmigs bskor nyer dgu pa'o// gtsug tor gyi bum can yang dmigs pa gtsug tor du byed pa'i khyad par ma gtogs de dang 'dra'o// dmigs bskor sum bcu pa'o// man ngag kho na las 'byung ba'i gsungs bum can ni/ rting pa gcig gis bshang sgo rten/ gcig gis gsang ba nas mnan/ lag pa gnyis gzhug chung nas phar 'khyid gang tsam gzhal ba'i sar btsugs/ gdong gyen du phyogs pas rlung drag la ring bar mnan/ bshang sgo dang gsang sgo gnyis ka nas thur sel lan mang du drangs pa de dang steng rlung gnyis kar rgyu zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan te bzhag pa'o// dmigs bskor so gcig pa'o// 'ga' zhig snying kha yan chad kyi bum can las dang po pas sgom du mi rung bar 'dod na'ang*/ rin tsam sgom pa la skyon med cing*/ las dang po pas sgom na lag len 'di ltar byed de/ lte ba'i bum can nyi shu tsam song nas snying kha'i bum can lan gcig gnyis tsam byed pa ste/ lte ba'i bum can de snying khar drang*/ sngar yang lte bar phab nas rlung gtong*/ mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor rnams la lte ba'i bum can yang mi 'dren yang*/ rlung gtong khar bum can lte bar 'bebs dgos so// slar yang de rnams kyi mthar gsang ba'i bum can tshar re bya/

rlung ro 'khyims kyi dogs pa yod na snying kha'i bum can gyi mthar ro stod gcud cing ha 'don/ mgrin pa'i mthar kha btsum nas mgrin pa'i rlung drangs te 'bud/ dpral ba dang gtsug tor gyi mthar sna bkag nas thod pa'i rlung drangs nas 'bud pa sogs kyang lags len bzhin shes par bya'o// gnyis pa (191)la/ rlung gi spogs chog ni/ rdo rje'i tshig drug gi gtum mo sbar ba'i sbyor bas srog thur bsre zhing 'chi med sgrub pa ste/ 'dzin pa'i man ngag sngar bstan pa de ltar bsgoms kyang yon tan skye ma 'dod na/ bum can tsam gyi srog thur bsre ma thub pa yin pas/ skyil krung g.yas g.yon gyi rol stabs sam/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis kyang chog la/ lag pa pus mo la bkab/ thog mar 'og sgo steng du 'then/ steng rlung hūm̐ ring gi gdangs kyis phyir 'bud/ slar nang du huṃ thung gis mnan te cung zad song nas gsang rlung hūm̐ gi khong sgra dang bcas te yar drangs/ lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ phaṭa ces yid la dran pas kha sbyor drag po de lte bar bzung bzhin pas/ lto ba phyir 'phul ba lan 'ga' bya/ de nas 'bud pa sogs sngar dang 'dra ste/ de nyid yang yang sgom pa yin no// 'di ni paṇa chen shākya shri'i man ngag yin la/ grub thob shā bā ri pa'i man ngag /bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra'i nye rgyud la srog thur bsre ba'i man ngag gsum yod pa ni gzhan du bshad par bya'o// dmigs bskor so gnyis pa'o// 'khrul 'khor gyi spogs chog ni/ rlung gnad snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe/ rkang sor nas lag pas 'jus te sgur langs su byed/ nang du rngubs te bzung ba'i skabs su 'phong*/ stan gyi steng du bzhag ste tsog su bya/ gsang rlung 'then skabs lus bsgyur/ lto ba phyir 'phul ba'i skabs ltag pa spyod do// dmigs bskor so gsum pa'o// rtsa'i spogs chog ni/ gong du bshad pa'i btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag pa nyid do// thig le'i spogs chog gtso bo ni/

dmigs bcas kyi gtum mo yin yang 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir mi brjod la/ rdo rje'i tshig drug gi lce gsum ga skyod pa'i sbyor bas nang gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ba ni/ dmigs (192)med dang dmigs bcas gnyis las/ 'dir dmigs bcas kyi dbang du byas na/ lag gnyis sa gnon bya/ gzhan lus gnad spyi dang 'dra/ dpral bar haṃ dkar po la dbyangs bcu drug dkar pos bskor ba'am/ yi ge gsal mi thebs na thig le dkar po bsgoms kyang rung ngo*// thur sel 'then byas pas rlung drod kyi rang bzhin tsan khogs pa nas yar song*/ yi ge'am thig le la phog pas bdud rtsi dkar po rlan drod kyi rang bzhin can 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs/ ya thod khengs/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlung kha nas shid kyi sgra dang bcas te lce thog tu drangs/ mchil ma dang lhan cig mig /lce rtse phugs su bzlog nas lce'u chung la reg /rlung stod smad du mnyam par dgags zhing bzung*/ lce chung las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rtsa'i nang thams cad khengs par mos/ de nyid yang yang bsgoms pas/ lce'u chung las rang byung gi bdud rtsi babs par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang las dang po pas bum can rnams sgom pa'i skabs rlung 'dus pa'i rtags 'gor na/ dmigs pa 'di lta bu sgom par bshad de/ rtsa 'khor so sor bshad tshod dang mthun par sgom thub na legs/ ma thub na/ rtsa 'khor rnams kyi 'khor lo nang kho na gsal btab pas chog pa/ lte ba sogs 'khor lo lnga la rtsa 'dab bzhi bzhi yin la/ gsang gnas la drug go /de yang lte ba'i bum can sgom na/ lte ba sprul 'khor ser po rtsa 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar dbu ma'i nang du zla ba la oṃ dkar po gsal btab/ der g.yas g.yon srog thur gyi rlung rnams thim par mos par byed/ de bzhin du/ snying kha'i 'khor lo dkar po dang*/ mgrin po'i 'khor lo dmar po dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo nag po dang*/ gtsug gtor gyi 'khor lo ljang gu dang*/

gsang ba'i 'khor lo sngon po rnams sgom pa'i khyad par ma togs/ bum can gzhan rnams (193)la'ang dmigs pa sngar mas rigs 'gre'o// thig le'i rnal 'byor drug po de rnams dmigs bskor gcig tu bsdu ste/ dmigs bskor so bzhi pa'o// spyir nas 'dzin pa'i bogs 'don ni/ srog rtsol gyi bogs 'don dang 'dra zhing*/ 'di'i spogs chog bogs 'don rnams kyang srog rtsol gyi skabs su 'jug pa yin no// gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ 'dzin pa'i mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag /bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/ dhā ra ṇa zhes 'dzin pa dang*/ gzung bya gnyis ka la 'jug pas sna tshogs su bsgyur ba yod kyang*/ 'dir ni rlung 'gro 'ong dang bral ba 'dzin pa'i don no// 'dzin pa'i yan lag dngos kyi dbang du byas na/ rlung dbu mar rtag tu babs cing srog dang thur sel 'dres pa'i dus na 'dzin pa sgom mo// rjes mthun pa ni srog rtsol dang 'dra'o// gsum pa sgom tshul gyi yan lag la don tshan lnga'i dang pa 'dzin pa gang la bya ba'i yul ni/ bde ba'i rlung ste/ mi shigs pa'i thig le dang 'dres pa'i rlung ngo*// gnyis pa bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems g.yo med du 'ching ba dang*/ mi 'gyur ba bde ba dngos su 'dren pa'i stong gzugs khyad par can 'byung ba'i rtsa ba gtum mo'i 'bar snang bsgrub pa'i phyir yin no// gsum pa dus ji tsam gyi bar du sgom pa ni 'khor lo lnga'am drug tu bum can ji ltar 'dod pa dgang nus pa la dbang 'byor bar de srid du'o// bzhi pa 'dzin pa rang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyud las/ thig ler srog ni rab tu zhugs shing gnyis ka'i bgrod pa bcom ste rtse gcig sems la 'dzin pa'o// zhes gsungs ste/ spyir 'khor lo lnga'am drug gi gnas su dbu ma'i thig le la steng 'og g.yas g.yon gyi rlung rnams (194)thim pa dang*/

khyad par mthar phyin pa na/ dpral ba'i thig le la srog rab tu zhugs pas thig le 'dzag med dpral bar brtan pa la sems zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ lnga pa 'dzin pa ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul la/ las dang po pas 'dzin pa rjes mthun pa sgom tshul ni gong du bshad pa de nyid yin cing*/ dngos ni bum pa can gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'khor lo drug tu sngar g.yas g.yon srog thur 'dres zin pa'i dbu ma'i rlung de nyid thig le la zhugs pa'i tshul gyis stong par thim pas gtum mo 'bar bar byed pa ste/ 'di la rgyud 'grel gyis 'dzin pa ston pa'i skabs phal cher na/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rnam bzhag las ma gsungs pa mang la/ dbye ba rnam pa bcu'i skabs na gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor yang 'gro ba bshad pas/ gtsug tor du yang 'dzin pa sgrub dgos pa ni yin la/ des na lte ba snying kha mgrin pa spyi bo gtsug tor te lnga la sngar ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs re dang*/ sngar thob zin brtan cing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i thabs re ste gnyis gnyis yod do// des na dpral ba'i thig le zhes bya ba yang dbu ma'i yal ga zhig gtsug tor nas smin 'tshams su 'khyogs pa'i gnas yin pa shes par bya zhing*/ gsang ba'i bum can ni/ rgyud 'grel nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang don la gnas shing snga ma rnams kyi gegs sel bogs 'don du 'gyur ba yin pas nges par sgrub ni dgos la/ logs su mi bgrang ba ni gtsug tor gyi bum can gyi cha lag tu sbyor bas so// bzhi pa ni/ spyir snga ma rnams dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par rgyud las re khā nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar gyur gyi bar du'o// ces dbu ma re khā nag po 'char ba dang*/ gtum mo'i 'bar snang dang*/ gzhom med kyi sgra'i sgo nas ches lhag pa yin la/ tshad ma ni srog rtsol dang 'dra'o// lnga (195)pa ni dag bya la dbye na/ tshor ba'i phung po sogs phung khams me khams pa drug tshan gcig yin la/

dag byed 'dzin pa'i lam nyid la dbye na/ ji skad du/ dri med 'od las/ srog gi 'dzin pa lte ba dang*/ snying kha dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ gtsug tor gyi pad+ma la 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i dbye bas rnams pa bcu'o// zhes pa ltar/ 'dzin pa la nyams rtogs mtho dman gyi dbye ba bcu yod do// drug pa la gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni rgyud las/ bdud dang nyon mongs la sogs nyams shing stobs bcu la ni 'jug par 'gyur te 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis so// zhes pa ltar/ rgas pa dang nad la sogs pa phung po'i sdug bsngal sel/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin shes pas lam du byed nus/ tshe la cung zad dbang thob/ 'dod yon gyi zhen pas mi 'ching bas bdud bzhi cung zad choms pa yin la/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur ba'ang yin no// rlung bcu thim pa'i mthu las/ lus ngag sems kyi stobs khyad par can yang grub ste/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud las// ma zos bkres med zos kyang 'ju// thur sel mi 'dzag bde ba rgyas// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che// lus yang la sogs mi rtog bde// zhes pa dang*/ tshe ring nad med khams cha snyoms// zhes gsungs mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni// rin chen 'byung ldan sogs lha me khams pa drug tshan gcig mngon du 'gyur ba yin no// sgom don 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o// des 'dzin pa'i 'khrid tshar ro// re zhig rjes dran gyi 'khrid mi 'bogs shing de tsam gyis chog par byed na/ rjes kyi 'khrid rnams skabs 'dir blang bar bya'o// gsum pa tha mar dag pa'i 'khrid la gnyis te/ rjes dran dang*/ ting nge 'dzin no// dang po la nyams len dmigs (196)pa'i gnad dang*/ sgom don blo la 'god pa'o// dang po la rjes dran dngos ni/ lus sbyor dang rlung gi rtsol ba sogs la ma ltos te/ 'khor lo drug pa'i rtsa mdud grol/ bde ba'i rlung la dbang thob/ gtum mo'i 'bar snang la ci dgar spyod pa'i skabs yin pas/

rgyud kyi dngos bstan las ji skad bshad pa kho na nyams su blangs pas chog go /'dir rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas te 'khrid pa la/ dngos dang yan lag go /dang po ni/ sor bsam la myong ba ci rigs par thon pa/ srog 'dzin gyis bum can phal ba yan chad legs par 'byongs pa/ srog thur bsre ba la myong ba thon pa zhig gi dbang du byas nas sgom mo// de la sngon 'go rlung sbyangs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul lo// dang po la/ 'dug stangs la bslab pas srog thur bsre ba brtan por byed pa dang*/ de'i yan lag bzung bzlog sogs kyi rlung sbyang ba dang*/ byed bcing lus kyi 'khrul 'khor la bslab pa ste gsum mo// dang po la/ khro bo seng ge'i 'dug stangs ni/ rkang pa bshang sgor bsnol/ pus mo bsrangs te tsog pu bya/ sgal tshigs bsrang*/ lag pa thab 'gal bya/ yang na/ pus btsugs rked pa bsrang*/ lag gnyis brla sbom phra'i mtshams su gtad ces kyang gzhan las bshad/ gang ltar mjing pa bstung zhing lta stangs gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'o// 'di mdun rtsa la gnad du bsnun pa yin/ yang de nyid las/ pus mo dang gru mos la 'dzugs pa'am yang na skyil krung sked pa bsrang*/ lag pa gnyis dpyi mgo'i thad kyis la 'dzugs/ lus sgyed cing mgrin pa dgug /'di rgyab kyi rtsa la gnad du bsnun pa yin/ zhi ma khro glang po che'i 'dug stangs ni/ pus btsugs lag gnyis khu tshur gyis 'gram (197)pa skyor/ gru mo stegs bu la gtsugs pa'am yang na rkang pa brkyang ba ste/ 'di ni mnyam pa'i rlung sbyor gyi steng nas thur sel steng du 'gro bar byed pa'o// yang skyil krung lus ltag sgyed du byed pa las/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyis sked pa'i rgyab nas brten pa'am/ yang na gan rkyal rkang pa gnyis cung zad brkyang pa pad+ma'i kha sbyor dang*/ lag pa khu tshur snying kha bsnol ba ste srog thur du 'dren par byed pa'o// 'di gnyis la lta stangs ni bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'o// zhi ba drang srong gi 'dug stangs la/

seng ge'i 'dug stangs dang 'dra ba las rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol ba dang*/ yang na tsog pu rting pa bteg /lag pa khu tshur bsnol bas rna ba nas bzung ba dang*/ zlum po'i rkang stabs la/ rdo rje'i khu tshur brla'i rtsa bar btsugs zhes kyang bshad de/ 'di dag kyang stod smad gnyis kyi rtsa la so sor gnad du bsnun pa yin la/ 'di gnyis la lta stangs ni thur du blta ba'o// de ltar ni 'dug stangs de dag kyang gnyis sdebs gnyis bsdebs kyis chog par bzhed kyang*/ drug pa thams cad byas na legs la/ drug ka la lugs gnyis bris pa'i snga ma rnams ni/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnams rgyal la sogs pa'i gsungs bzhin yin la// yang na zhes pa rnams grub chen yu mo'i man ngag thor bu ba dang*/ kun spangs chen po'i thugs sras la stod pa dbang rgyal la sogs pa'i lag len 'ga' zhig la snang ba ltar bkod pa yin pa las/ phyi ma 'di rnams 'chun che che tsam du snang zhing*/ drug tshan gnyis po 'di gang rung zhig gis chog pas/ gnyis ka phrugs gcig la sbyor mi dgos so// 'di la thun gsum du byed pa'ang yod la/ mgyogs 'khrid la thun gcig tu byas pas/ dmigs bskor (198)so lnga pa'o// de nas dag 'dren ni/ 'og rlung 'then cing hūm̐ ring gis steng rlung phyir bsal/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi zhes pas 'khor lo lnga la rim pas dmigs shing*/ steng rlung drag tu mnan/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā/ zhes pas khong sgra dang bcas te 'khor lo lnga la rim pas dmigs shing*/ gsang rlung drag tu steng du drangs/ de ma thag kha sbyor lte bar bzung la phyir bskyed/ 'og sgo bsdams shing shes pa dpral bar gtad do// sngar gyi lus gnad drug pa so so'i steng du rlung sbyor 'di rnams la 'bad dgos te/ lus gnad kyi khyad par ma gtog /rlung gnad ni 'dzin pa'i spogs chog dang phal cher 'dra ba yin no// dmigs bskor so drug pa'o// yang sgom stegs dang pus 'khyud bcug

/me thab drug chings su grags pa byas la hā ring dang bstun lag pa khu tshur bcang*/ gru mo pus mo la thug gi bar du lag pa brkyang ste rlung phyir 'bud/ de ltar lan bdun bdun na lag pa thab 'gal byas/ 'jam rlung bzung ste ngal gso len re bya'o// dmigs bskor so bdun pa'o// de dag ma mtha' yang zla ba tsam sgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ tsog pu 'phong stegs bcug /lag pa brla nang nas 'khyud de ngar gdong bzung*/ rlung kha nas phyir drag tu bus/ 'og sgo glod/ yang rngubs te lto ba phyir bskyed pa'i ngang nas/ slar yang 'og sgo glod de rlung gang thub bzung ngo*// rlung gnad dang po yin cing 'og la bsre ba dang 'dzin pa ste dbye bsdud ces bya'o// yang de dang 'dra ba las/ dgang gtong gnyis ka'i skabs lto ba tshigs pa la bcar zhing thur sel drag tu drangs/ ro stod 'then/ ngar gdong mnan pa'o// rlung gnad gnyis pa yin/ steng la bsre ba dang bskyil ba ste/ sgo glegs ces bya'o// yang lus gnad de'i ngang nas/ (199)thur sel drag tu bsnol rjes phyir bus te/ stong 'dren drag tu bya/ yang rngubs te kha sbyor dgang 'then gyi ngang nas lto ba bskyod sgyed bskyog /ro stod gcu/ lag pa brkyang nas lag sor gcud/ mgrin pa gcu zhing mgo sprugs nas rlung phyir 'bud/ phyir bzung ka ba btsugs nas mgo dgug bskyod/ mgrin pa/ ro stod/ lte ba'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ de dag thams cad la 'dar sprug dang*/ mjug tu 'bebs bya/ rlung gnad gsum pa yin/ 'di la kun 'dus ces bya'o// skyil krung lag gnyis khu tshur brla gnon bya/ cung zad sgur nas hūm̐ zhes thur sel 'then/ stong 'dren g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bya/ yang rlung kha sbyor gyen 'then mgo sgyed cing sprul pa yang g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bya'o// rlung gnad bzhi pa yin no// 'di la 'dus pa ces bya ste/ de gnyis 'dren khyab bo// de rnams gcig rting la gcig bya zhing*/

lus sbyong la'ang 'bad par bya'o// dmigs bskor so brgyad pa'o// 'di dag mgyogs 'khrid kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ 'grub na rlung sbyor re la dmigs bskor rer byed pa legs shing*/ de thams cad la yang sems kyi bzhag stangs ni/ mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi ngang nas stong gzugs la dmigs shing*/ de'i ngang nas rlung gi gnad gang du gcud pa der sems gtad cing lhod kyis glod par byed dgos/ dmigs pa de dang rlung sbyor de dag sbrags nas sgom pa chu tshod gcig gnyis kyi yun re bya zhing*/ lhag ma bum can gyi rnal 'byor la brtson par byed dgos te/ dmigs bskor so dgu pa'o// de dag la yang zla gcig tsam ma mthar sgom mo// 'di skabs dmigs gsal med pa rnams la lta (200)stangs thad kar lta ba gtso che la 'og dngos gzhi'i skabs/ yan lag med pa'i lta ba zhes bya ba/ bde ba gang du skyes pa'i phyogs la lta ba yin pas gcig tu ma nges so// gsum pa ni/ de nas 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams bya ste/ de yang*/ sbyor ba drug pa stag mo'i skyug /glang chen 'gying ba wa yi bsnol// seng ge rnams grol khong dkrugs dang*// pre ta ka dang yongs 'dzin dang*// 'dren chung khong 'dren 'dren chen dang*// spags 'dren 'phar g.yo phur 'don dang*// rab brkyang dang ni seng ge'i rtsal// gcu 'then dang ni gsum 'dren dang*// seng ge'i 'gying dang rma bya'i 'gyur// zhes pa ltar gyi/ 'khrul 'khor lag len rim pas bslabs nas/ bum pa can dang sngar gyi rlung sbyor rnams dang bcas pa sgom du gzhug dgos pa las/ sor bsam srog 'dzin rnams la myong ba cung zad thon pa zhig gis/ thun drug tu 'khrul 'khor de dag tshar re re nus na/ zla gcig tsam na dngos gzhi sgom du rung ba'i rtags rnams 'byung ngo*// rtsol ba che chung la ltos te yun ring thung ji ltar bskyang dgos pa'ang 'dis rigs 'gre ste/

dmigs bskor bzhi bcu pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rjes dran gyi yan lag rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas te/ phyag rgya chen mo gcig sbyor mos pa'i yul du bzhag nas/ 'dir gsum ste/ sgom pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya la bslabs pa rang lus lag pa'i phyag rgya la bslab pa/ gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ lus gnad spyi dang 'dra ba las// lag pa khu tshur snying khar bsnol// lta stangs thad kar g.yo med du lta ba'o// rang nyid dus 'khor lhan skyes yab yum la sogs par gsal (201)gdab/ de'i shul du stong gzugs kyi snang ba legs par drangs/ lha skur snang ba stong gzugs kyis khyab par byas la/ de la yid mi g.yo bar cung zad bzhag /stong gzugs kyi snang ba de ltar 'dren mi thub na/ lha sku gsal stong la dmigs te cung zad bzhag /de nas dpral bar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ nag po// lte bar haṃḥser po// gsang bar swā sngon po/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu'o// yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po phra mos mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba'i nang du āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad phra mos mtshan pa gsal btab/ de nas 'khyud pa la sogs pa rjes chags kyi spyod pa mdzad pas gtsug tor gyi thig le zhu nas dpral ba'i 'khor lo yan chad gang bar mos stong gzugs dang bsre/ lus gnad de ka'i steng nas gtsug tor dang dpral ba'i bum can yun thung ngu re bya/ dga' ba dang po'i skad cig ma'o// rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyar bas sngar gyi thig le'i rgyun de nyid cher rgyas shing zhu ste/ mgrin pa dang snying kha'i 'khor lo yan chad gang bar mos/ stong gzugs dang bsre/ mgrin pa dang snying kha'i bum can snga ma gnyis las yun ring tsam re bzung*/

mchog tu dga' ba'i skad cig ma'o// dbang po gnyis srub pa'i sbyor ba las/ byang chub kyi sems snga ma'i rgyun las kyang cher rgyas shing zhu bas/ lte ba dang*/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo yan chad gang bar bsam la lte ba dang gsang ba'i bum can yun ring bar bsgom/ khyad par dga' ba'i skad gcig ma'o// (202)yang drag tu srub pa las/ gsang ba nas rdo rje nor bus bar du byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bar mos/ stong gzugs la ring du mnyam par 'jog bzhin pas/ bum pa can gyi sbyor ba gcig dang*/ sbyor ba drug pa zhes bya ba'i 'khrul 'khor bcas pas rdo rje nor bur byang chub kyi sems phyir 'pho ba 'gags te khyil li li 'khyil bar bsam/ lhan skyes dga' ba'i skad cig ma'o// de nas thog mar yongs 'dzin gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas par mos/ de'i rjes su/ khod 'dren dang*/ 'dren chen dang*/ sbags 'dren dang*/ stag mo dang*/ glang chen dang*/ wa snom rnams kyis gtsug tor gyi bar du bzlog par bsam/ de nas pra ta ka dang rnams grol dang*/ g.yang sprugs dang*/ 'phar g.yo dang*/ phur 'don dang*/ rab brkyang rnams kyis lus thams cad la khyab par byas par bsam/ seng ge'i rtsal dang*/ gcud 'then dang*/ gsum 'grems dag seng ge 'gying dang*/ rma bya'i 'gyur rnams kyis gzung bzlog 'grems gsum kar byas par bsam/ spyir ni bzung zhing bzlog /bzlog cing 'grems/ 'grems shing rlung dang bsre/ bsre zhing ye shes chen por bskyal zhes bya ba yin pas/ gong gi rim pa rnams ni gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ re re la'ang gnad bzhi car tshang ba'i man ngag gis gnad du 'gro bar bya'o// ci ste dmig pa gsal bas dngos su zhu bde bskyed thub na/ sbyor ba drug pos bzung ma thag tu 'khrul 'khor spang ba'i rlung sbyor rnams kyis bzung bzlog khyab pa rnams btud mar sbyangs la/ de'i rjes su 'khrul 'khor rnams bya zhing*/

thog mar spyod pa'i skabs zhu bde bskyed thub rung mi thub rung*/ de thams cad rdzogs par bya dgos la/ phyis shin tu byang nas bzlog pa dang 'gram pa gnad cha ba re tsam gyis chog go /gang ltar yang*/ mthar rlung dang (203)bsre ba'i phyir bum pa can mang du sgom zhing*/ ye shes chen por skyel ba'i phyir zhu bde'i nyams dang 'od gsal rtags snang la dmigs nas mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi ngang bskyang bar bya'o// dmigs bskor zhe gcig pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyud las/ bsten pa'i don du lag pa'i phyag rgya rang gi snying gi dbang po'i skyon rnams kun las rnam par grol/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lag pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gnad rnams gong yi rgya dang 'dra la/ 'di ni ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang las kyi phyag rgya'i mtshams sbyor ba yin la/ phyag rgya gsum gyi nang nas ye shes kyi phyag rgyar gtogs so// dmigs bskor zhe gnyis pa'o// gsum pa ni/ 'grel chen du rtsa rgyud kyi lung drangs pa las// bcu drug lo lon rigs can ma// gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa la// dang por legs par bslab byas nas// dbang bskur nas ni bsgrub par brtsam/ sku gsung thugs dang chags pa ni// dpral ba la sogs rnams su dgod// swā hā gsang ba gtsug tor che// ces sogs dang*/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i snyems// 'dzin cing rnal 'byor hūm̐ phaṭa bya// bha gar ling ga rab bkod nas// byang chub sems ni spro mi bya// khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i// sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya// lte ba gtum mo 'bar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan ma mig la sogs pa yang*// bsregs nas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /bdud rtsi khu ba'i chos can ni// thig le'i gzugs kyis 'dzag par byed// thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes par grags// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ sngar ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i skabs su bshad pa (204)yid ngor sgom pa dang*/

'dir dngos su sgrub pa'i khyad par te gzhan ni phal cher 'dra'o// de ltar na yid kyi phyag rgya dang*/ lag pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ las kyi phyag rgya gsum car la stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dang*/ bsre ba yod na ni dran rjes mthun par 'gyur la/ stong gzugs dang bsre ba med na spyir gnad du 'gro ba yod kyang rjes dran gyi phyogs su ni mi gtogs la/ yan lag snga ma rnams kyi bogs 'don spogs chog tu 'gyur ba ni yod do// las rgya da lta dngos su mi 'grub kyang*/ lam gyi 'gang gcig yin pas chos mthun gcig ste/ dmigs bskor zhe gsum pa'o// gnyis pa yan lag gi dmigs pa ni/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor te/ de yang lus gnad sngar dang mthun pa'am/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pas spyi bo bkag /lce rkan la sbyar/ lto ba tshigs pa la bcer bar 'dod pa yod pa ltar byas kyang rung*/ rtsa 'khor rnams la dmigs pa gsal na rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul dang mthun par rgyas pa sgom ste/ lte ba la nang bskor 'dab ma bzhi/ de'i phyi rol brgyad/ de'i phyi rol bcu gnyis/ de'i phyi bskor drug cu'am drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ de bzhin du/ snying kha'i nang bskor la bzhi/ phyi bskor la brgyad/ mgrin pa'i nang bskor la bzhi/ bar bskor la brgyad/ phyi bskor la sum cu so gnyis/ spyi bo'i nang bskor la bzhi/ bar bskor la brgyad/ phyi bskor la bcu drug go /gtsug tor la phyi bskor nang bskor gyi dbye ba med de 'dab ma bzhi'o// gsang ba'i nang bskor la drug /bar bskor la bcu/ phyi bskor la bcu drug go /'on kyang de tsam gsal 'debs pa dka' ba byung na/ 'khor lo (205)lnga po rnams la rtsa 'dab bzhi bzhi dang*/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab drug pa rnams gsal btab pas chog /skabs der bsdus pa 'di'i dbang du byas na/ 'di ltar sgom te/ rang lus lha skur gsal ba khong stong du gnas pa'i g.yas g.yon gang la yang ma yo bar dbus drang thad/

mdun du rgyab gnyis las rgyab la lhag par nye ba na/ rtsa dbu ma lte ba sprul 'khor yan chad la kha dog ljang khu yar sna spyi bo tshangs bug la zug pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po dbu ma las pa ldabs 'gyur gyis phra ba/ de gsum sum gzhibs su gsal 'debs la/ yas sna nas sor gang tsam gyi 'og tu gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo// smin mtshams te dpral ba'i gung smad kyi tshad tsam na dpral ba'am spyi bo'i 'khor lo// phrag pa g.yas g.yon skye ba'i mtshams kyi thad du mgrin pa'i 'khor lo// nu ma gnyis kyi bar ka'i thad tsam du snying kha'i 'khor lo// lte ba'i khung bu'i thad tsam du lte ba'i 'khor lo// 'khor lo rnams kyi thad du ro rkyang gi lag re dbu ma dang spubs 'brel ba/ phyi rol ro rkyang dbu ma gsum la rtsa'i rked dkris byas pa lta bu/ sked dkris de las rtsa 'dab rnams yal ga sbubs can lta bu skyes par bsgom la/ de yang gtsug tor dang*/ spyi bo dang*/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ma bzhin du kha thur bstan dang*/ snying kha dang*/ lte ba gdugs 'degs bzhin du kha gyen bstan no// 'khor lo rnams kyi kha dog skabs 'dir gtsug tor gyi ljang khu/ spyi bo'i nag po// mgrin pa'i dmar po/ snying kha'i dkar po/ lte ba'i ser pa'o// mi'i lus kyi dbang du byas na lte ba nas 'og tu sor (206)brgyad dam bcu tsam gzhal la/ rgyu zhabs kyi phyogs lus kyi dbus nad gsang gnas bde skyong gyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po kha gyen bstan zhig bsgom// de'i bar gyi dbu ma'i mas sna ni dung can ma ste/ kha dog sngon po dang*/ ro rkyang gnyis po lte ba'i 'khor lo'i 'og 'tshams nas gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i bar du g.yas su ro ma'i mas sna nag po dang*/ g.yon du brkyang ma'i mas sna ser po ste/ rtsa gsum sum gzhibs so// de ltar 'khor lo drug la dbu ma yang sbom phra mda' smyug tsam bsam/

gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba'i 'og nas dbu ma'am dung can ma'i mas sna cha phra ba g.yas kyi phyogs dang*/ ro ma'i mas sna g.yon gyi phyogs bzung ste/ nyis gzhibs lta bur byas nas cung zad mdun du 'khyogs te gsang bar zug la rkyang ma'i mas sna 'khor lo'i lte ba nas dbus kyi phyogs bzung nas cung zad rgyab phyogs su 'khyogs te bshang sgo la zug par sgom/ dbu ma'i nang gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su āḥsngon po dang*/ lte bar hoḥyig ser po yi ge'i mgo lte ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du tshud tsam/ de'i steng sor gang tsam ma reg pa yi ge l̥ yig ser po/ snying gar u yig dkar po/ mgrin par ri yig dmar po// spyi bo i yig nag po/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i 'og mtshams su a yig ljang khu/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i lte bar klad kor chud cing gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i steng nas yi ge'i gzugs mgo zhabs bzlog pa'i haṃ yig dkar po rnams gsal btab/ de nas bum pa can bsgoms pas gsang ba'i dbus kyi āḥlas rlung drod kyi rang bzhin can dung can ma nas song*/ de nas ho yig bskul bas de las gtum mo ye shes kyi me phra ba/ 'tshor ba/ mkhrang ba/ rno ba/ tshwa ba/ rtsub pa/ (207)gser gyi kha dog can gtso che ba'i kha dog sna drug pa 'bar bas/ 'khor lo lnga la gnas pa'i l̥ u ṛ i a rnams phug cing bsregs/ haṃ la reg pas byang chub kyi sems zhu ste/ a i ri u l̥ rnams kyang rim pas gsos la/ de rnams kyi dwangs ma zhu ba'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres te hoḥyig la khrus gsol zhing rtsa 'khor lo drug gang bar mos/ dmigs bskor zhe bzhi pa'o// yang gtum mo bsdus pa ni/ rtsa 'khor lo drug gsal btab/ gtsug tor gyi dbu ma'i nang du thig le dkar po ba'i nu ma lta bu ring thung sor bzhi tsam dang*/ lte bar gtum mo dbyug pa'i gzugs can kha dog dmar po sor bzhi pa gsal btab la/

bum pa can bzung ba'i gtum mo'i me 'od rab tu rgyas te/ rtsa 'khor lo drug sogs lus kyi nang thams cad kha dog dmar lam pa dang*/ drod tsha 'ur byung bar mos/ rim pas spyi bo'i thig le zhu bas dbu mar babs pas/ de'i 'od kyis lus nang thams cad dkar lam pa dang*/ bde chil gyis byung bar bsam/ mthar thig le gtum mo la thim/ mi rtog par cung zad bzhag /gtum mo'i rnam grangs gzhan ni/ snying kha'i 'khor lo nag po dang*/ lte ba'i 'khor lo ser po kha sbyor gyi 'bar 'dzag dang*/ mgrin par dmar po dang spyi bo dkar po kha sbyor gyi 'bar 'dzag dang*/ gtsug tor ljang khu dang gsang ba sngon po kha sbyor gyi 'bar 'dzag byed pa'ang yod do// gtum mo 'di lta bu la sogs pa dmigs bcas dang mos sgom gyi rdzogs rim du grags pa 'di rnams ngo bo bskyed rim du gtogs kyang*/ rdzogs rim gyis ye shes skye ba'i rgyu khyad par can bya ba'i phyir de'i tha bsnyad brtags pa ste/ las dang po pa rnams la nges (208)par dgos shing*/ rdzogs rim dngos kyi ye shes skyes nas kyang 'di dag bogs 'don du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ci rigs par sgom par bya ba kho na'o// dmigs bskor zhe lnga pa'o// rjes dran dngos rgyud la skyes pa'i dus rdo rje'i lus la gtum mo yongs rdzogs su 'bar zhing*/ dga' bzhi yongs rdzogs 'dren thub pa yin la/ da lta gtum mo sgom pa ni de lta bu'i rnam pa lam byed dang*/ de yang stong gzugs dang bsre thub na ni rjes dran rjes mthun pa yin no// gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la rjes dran gyi mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag /bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/ rgya skad du/ a nu zhes pa rjes su dang*/ smṛ ti zhes pa dran par bsgyur la// a nu'i sgra ni dman pa dang*/

lhag pa la 'jug pa gnyis las/ skabs 'dir lhag pa'i don te/ a nu smṛ ti zhes pa rjes su dran pa lhag par dran pa'i don te/ sngar bsgoms pa slar yang dran zhing shin tu dran pa ste/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po la yang yang sgom zhing drag tu rtsol ba'i don no// gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin pa mthar phyin pas rtsa rlung thig le gsum la dbang 'byor/ gtum mo'i snang ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi lha sku rab 'byams su shar na nges par rjes dran sgom ran pa'o// gsum pa sgom tshul gyi yan lag la/ don tshan lnga las rjes dran gang la bya ba'i yul ni/ spyir rtsa rlung thig le thams cad dang*/ gtso bo gtum mo'i 'bar snang gi stong gzugs dang*/ rten 'khor lo bzhi'am drug gi thig le/ brten pa zhu bde dang bcas pa'o// don tshan gnyis pa dgos pa ni// mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba dngos su sgrub pa'i phyir te// zhu bde 'dzag med la bslab pa'o// don (209)tshan gsum pa dus ji tsam gyi bar du sgom pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skad cig ma dang po ma skyes kyi bar du'o// mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skyes zin pa'i rjes su yang rjes dran gyi rgyun bor nas/ dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i lam gsal po sgom du med kyi/ rjes dran gyi rgyun nyid ting nge 'dzin du gnas gyur pa yin no// don tshan bzhi pa rjes dran rang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyud las/ gtum mo'i snang bar gang zhig gyur pa nges par lus dang nam mkha' la yang rjes su dran par 'gyur/ zhes gsung te/ grogs phyag rgya gzhan yod kyang rung*/ med kyang rung*/ gtum mo'i 'bar snang gi lha yab yum mnyam sbyor gtso bor gyur pa'i stong gzugs phra rags srid pa gsum gyi rnams pa can la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par gzhag pas/ zhu bde 'dzag med yang yang bskyed pa la rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin no// don tshan lnga pa rjes dran ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/

rgyud las/ 'di dag dman pa la sogs dbye ba rnams kyis sna tshogs gtso bo'i sgrub thabs rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ phyag rgya gsum dang gnas skabs gsum ni rnam gsum bgrod pa'i dbang gis las dang kun rtog mchog rnams so// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po dbang po brtul zhing thig le sla ba'i gnas skabs na/ las kyi phyag rgya la ma bsten par/ dga' bzhi rdzogs par 'dren mi thub pa'i skabs na/ las dang ye shes phyag chen gsum kar gcig tu dril ba'i rjes dran sgom/ de nas dbang po na 'phos te bar skabs der dbang po 'bring du gyur pa/ thig le cung zad bska ba'i gnas skabs su song ba na/ phyag chen kho nas ni bde ba rdzogs par 'dren mi thub la/ las rgya ni med kyang chog pa'i skabs su/ las rgya spangs te/ ye rgya dang phyag chen gcig tu dril ba'i rjes (210)dran sgom/ yang dbang po na 'phar te rnon por song*/ byang chub kyi sems shin tu bska ba'i gnas skabs su gyur pa na/ phyag chen kho nas zhu bde rdzogs par ni 'dren thub/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ma thob pa'i skabs der phyag chen kho na la brten pa'i rjes dran sgom/ de dag kyang mnyam bzhag gtso che ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ rjes thob tu brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang 'brel ba la ni nges pa med do// gnas skabs gsum po 'di rnams la phyag chen bzhi sbyor dang*/ phyag rgya gsum sbyor dang*/ phyag rgya gnyis sbyor zhes 'dod pa dang*/ yang gsum sbyor/ gnyis sbyor/ gcig sbyor zhes rim pas sbyor ba'ang yod do// bzhi pa las/ rtags ni dga' bzhi rdzogs par 'dren things re las gtum mo'i 'bar snang mtha' yas pa 'phro tshul gong nas gong du khyad zhugs par 'byung la/ kuṇ+ḍa byang chub kyi sems lhung bar rtsol kyang mi lhung ste/ nor bu nas shugs drag pos gyen la rang bzlog tu 'gro ba dang*/ rang gi lus kyang stong gzugs 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du snang ba dang*/

dag pa dang ma dag pa'i srid pa gsum gyi gzugs brnyan rtag par spro zhing bsdu ba'o// tshad ma ni mngon sum bzhi car tshad yang nang gi bde ba dam pa nyams su myong zhing rig pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ rang rigs mngon sum gtso che'o// lnga pa ni/ dag bya la dbye na 'du shes la sogs pa phung khams chu'i khams pa drug tshan gcig tu dbye/ dag byed rjes dran gyi yan lag la dbye na bcu ste rgyud las/ bsam dang 'dod dang lus la rims dang kha mchog pad+ma skams dang zas la rab tu mi 'jug dang*/ 'dar dang smyo dang rab tu rmongs par 'gyur dang yid ni rnams par 'khrul dang drag tu brgyal ba dag /rdo rje can gyi du ba la sogs rab gsal rnam pa bcu ste srog chags lus la 'jig (211)rten du/ rab tu gsal zhing nges pa de rnams yid gsum gnas skabs su zhig rgyal bar 'dod pa de ni su/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ rtags bcu'i dbye ba can gyi stong gzugs so sos rim pas bde ba 'dren pa na/ bsam pa'i gnas skabs dang mtshungs shing*/ de rnam par dag pa'i bde ba dang po thob pa la sogs pa/ bde ba mi 'dra ba bcu rim gyis thob pa yin no// drug pa las/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ rjes su dran pas legs par dag pa dri med 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag kyang ye shes gzugs las so// zhes pa ltar/ rtsa nang thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bas phyi nang thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis khyab pa dang*/ rnam smin gyi lus gnas ma 'gyur yang rang sems lha skur dngos su gyur pa dang*/ gzhan yang mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa mtha' yas pa thob cing*/ bde stong gi nyams myong rgyun mi 'chad pa yin la mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la sogs la lha chu khams pa drug tshan gcig gi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ro// sgom don 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o// des rjes dran gyi 'khrid tshar ro// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khrid ston par byed pa la/

nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ sgom tshul blo la 'god pa'o// dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dngos kyi dbang ltar byas nas/ phyag chen kho na'i rjes dran dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ sbogs chog tu las kyi phyag rgya tha dad pa mang du sgrub par bshad pa yin la/ 'dir ni mos pa lam byed tsam du sgom na/ rjes dran rjes mthun pa dang 'dra ba las/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dang*/ lta stongs sna rtse rang bab pa'i tshul gyis lta gsung*/ dmigs pa'i skabs su yas brten dga' (212)bzhi ni rjes dran dang 'dra/ mas brtan la rtsa 'khor so sor bum can yun ring du sgom zhing*/ stong gzugs dang bde ba la mnyam par 'jog /ting nge 'dzin gyis bcu gnyis thob par mos pa tsam bya'o// dmigs bskor zhe drug pa'o// dmigs bskor 'di mtha' gcig tu ma byas kyang chog mod/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis/ yan lag drug gi dmigs pa'i sa bcad mi stongs pa'i phyir mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa sgom don blo la 'god pa la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan don/ sgom pa'i dus mtshams/ sgom tshul gyi yan lag /bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad/ dag bya dag byed kyi dbye ba/ bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ste drug las/ dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dhi zhes pa ting nge 'dzin te/ de yang mnyam par kun tu 'dzin pa'i don yin pas/ gzung 'dzin dang bral zhing*/ yul yul can dbyer med pa sems gnas pa'i don no// gnyis pa ni/ rjes dran gyi yan lag mthar phyin te/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 'phral du bskyed nus pa na'o// gsum pa la/ don tshan lnga'i dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi yul ni/ stong gzugs dang bde chen gnyis yin la/ don tshan gnyis pa bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i don dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i lus dbyings su dag ste/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku thob pa'i phyir ro// don tshan gsum pa dus ji tsam gyi bar du bsgom pa ni/

ting nge 'dzin gyi thog ma mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skad gcig gcig thob nas/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yongs su rdzogs par thob kyi bar du'o// don tshan bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ni rgyud las/ shes rab thabs (213)kyi bdag nyid kyis ni 'gyur med bde ba'i dbang gis ye shes gzugs la ting nge 'dzin ni/ zhes te/ ye shes gcig nyid la/ ldog cha'i dbye bas shes rab mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang*/ thabs rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes kyi sku gnyis so sor mthong ba'i gnyis snang gi cha med par zung 'jug tu nyams su myong ba'i ting nge 'dzin te/ zhu bde 'dzag med mthar phyin pas rkyen byas nas/ las rlung gcig 'gags/ rtsa gsum bcu cha gcig dbu mar thim/ khams dkar dmar gyi bgrod pa re re dbu ma'i nang du g.yo med du brtan zhes bya ste/ de ltar rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ khams rnams phyin chad du 'jig tu med cing rgyun mi 'chad pa'i stong gzugs su gyur pa na/ de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i ye shes ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhes bya'o// de phyir/ stong gzugs bde bas rig pa la// bde ba chen po rang gi rig /ces gsungs so// don tshan lnga pa ting nge 'dzin ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud las/ bde ba ma nyams gcig pu zhi ba lhan skyes ye shes rnal 'byor 'dir ni sgrub pa chen po la/ zhes dang*/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud las kyang*/ sgom pa dmigs bcas stong gzugs dang*// dmigs med bde ba ro mnyam la// sems ni mi g.yo brtan par gnas// dngos po thams cad bde bar 'char// zhes pa ltar sngar gnas gyur zin gyi thig le rnams kyi mi 'gyur ba'i bdag dang*/ phyis gnas 'gyur rgyud lta gnas mi 'gyur ba'i thig le dbab bzlog gi zhu bde 'dzag med gnyis tshogs pa gcig tu gyur pas/ sems bde ba thob pa'i ngang na/ stong gzugs la rab tu chags pas zhu bde 'dzag med yang yang bsgrub par yin la/

rjes thob (214)tu spros bcas kyi spyod pa rtag tu spyod pa'am// bogs 'don spogs chog gi tshul du ci rigs par spyod dgos pa yin no// bzhi pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi mthar thug pa ma mthong ba'i don yang dag par mthong ba nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i don yang dag par mthong ba'i bar du ste/ tshad ma ni mngon sum bzhi car tshang ba las/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi dbang du byas nas/ 'phags pa'i ye shes rjes mthun pa yin pas rnal 'byor mngon sum zhes bya'o// lnga pa ni/ dag bya la dbye na gzugs phung sogs phung khams sa khams pa drug tshan gcig yin la/ dag byed ting nge 'dzin la dbye na/ 'khor lo drug tu las rlung 'gags pa'i dbye bas sa bcu gnyis sam// ting nge 'dzin rnam pa bcu ni rlung bcu po rnams 'gog pa'i phyir ro// zhes pas/ thur sel la sogs pa'i rlung bcu phyin chad mi skye ba'i chos can du rtsa ba nas 'gags pa'i dbye bas rim pa bcu'o// drug pa la gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyis dag pa nyen zhag 'ga' zhig rnams kyi ye shes sku ni 'grub par gyur// zhes gsungs te/ ting nge 'dzin dang po skyes pa nas/ rgyun ma chad par bsgom na/ lo gsum dang phyogs gsum gyis gnas lugs yang dag pa bden pa'i sa mngon du byed cing rnam par smin pa'i lus dbyings su thim nas/ gnyis su med pa zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i sku 'grub bo// de ni dbang bcu la sogs pa yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po yin la/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad (215)la sogs pa lha sa khams pa drug tshan gcig gi dkyil 'khor mngon du 'gyur ro// sgom don 'di la thun gcig la sogs pa'o// des ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khrid tshar te/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa rnams bstan zin to// gsum pa rjes lam gyi yan lag

/sa mtshams/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs pa dang bcas pa la gsum ste/ lam gyi yan lag dang*/ sa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang rnal 'byor mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ nyer mkho cung zad brjod pa la// nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor dang*// 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos 'dzin dang*// 'da' kha 'pho ba'i gdams ngag dang*// bar do 'dun pas 'dzin pa dang*// thun sgom gyis mnyam rjes bsre ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ spyir gnyid kyi rnal 'byor la gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal 'dzin pa dang*/ rmi lam gyi gdams ngag gnyis yod/ gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal 'dzin pa la/ las dang po pas 'od gsal 'dzin tshul ni/ sngar sor bsam pa'i skabs su bstan pa de yin la/ thabs des gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i rnal 'byor pa la ni/ srog rtsol phan chad du gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag logs par mi dgos mod/ spyir ni lugs 'di la mgrin snying kha sbyor gyis 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i man ngag dang*/ lte snying kha sbyor gyis 'od gsal spel ba'i man ngag kyang yod do// des na skabs 'dir rmi lam gyi gdams ngag ni/ rang gi mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i (216)dbus su ra yig dmar po dang*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus su thig le dkar po gsal btab nas/ 'jam rlung bag tsam bzung bas ṛ yig las gtum mo 'bar/ thig le la reg /de nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te/ ṛ yig la thim par bsam la/ do nub cis kyang rmi lam zin par bya'o// zhes 'dun pa drag po bcu gnas bsgoms nas myur du rmi lam zin par 'gyur ro// dmigs bskor zhe bdun pa'o// rmi lam zin cing zin pa de yang brtan por song na/ mgrin par stong gzugs drangs te/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de dang bsres nas/ do nub kyis kyang rmi lam du rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o// zhes 'dun pa drag po btang bas/ rmi lam du sar bsam la sogs pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i 'dun pa skyes te/

dmigs pa la sems gtad pa'i tshe stong gzugs mang po bde nyams dang bcas te 'char ba'ang yod/ dang po nyid nas rmi lam dang stong gzugs 'dres mar 'char ba'ang yod/ rtsa bzang zhing dbang po rno ba dang*/ phyis shin tu goms par gyur na/ dbang po rno brtul thams cad la yang 'char ste/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dran med de gsang ma thag tu rmi lam gyi dod la stong gzugs 'ba' zhig 'bar ba'ang yod do// dmigs bskor zhe brgyad pa'o// gnyis pa la/ 'chi ka'i gdams ngag dngos dang*/ sgom 'phro la shi yang rnal 'byor goms stobs 'jug par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ da lta'i dus nas bdag 'chi ba'i tshe/ sa chu la thim pas du ba zhes pa la sogs (217)pa'i rtags snang mang po dang*/ bying ba dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ 'phar g.yo la sogs pa'i lus nyams du ma dang*/ dbugs 'dar ba dang*/ rngam rgod la sogs pa'i dag nyams du ma dang*/ gsal ba dang mi gsal ba dang*/ khro ba dang*/ chags pa la sogs pa sems nyams du ma 'byung bar 'dug pa la/ de rnams rang ngo shes par byas nas/ sems 'od gsal du 'jug dgos par 'dug snyam du 'dun pas mtshams sbyor la/ rang 'chi ba'i dus su yang sgom tshul 'di lta bu yin snyam pas/ yan lag drug po gong skabs su bab pa de sgom la/ lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams/ mthong nyams gang byung yang 'chi kha'i sgom tshul yang 'di lta bu byed snyam pas/ nyams gang shar de la skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar ngos gzung la mnyam par gzhag /khyad par gnyid du 'gro kha dang*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal la yang 'dun pa de bzhin du sbyongs ba gal che/ dmigs bskor zhe dgu pa'o// nam zhig 'chi ba mngon du babs pa'i tshe/ mthong snang gang shar yang de la mi g.yo gsum ldan du bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i dbyings de ngos zin par bya/ de bzhin du lus ngag la bde sdug gi nyams gang byung yang 'dra/ sems la dga' sdug chags sdang ci shar yang 'dra/

rna bar sgra ji ltar thos kyang rung ste de dang de la mi g.yo ba gsum ldan gyi sgo nas rig pa gtad de/ rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa de rig thog tu bskyang ngo*// srog rtsol man chad goms pa'i (218)rnal 'byor pa yin na/ 'chi ltas byung zhing 'chi ba mi bzlog par shes pa tsam na/ bum pa can dang stong gzugs la mnyam par 'jog pa la 'bad rtsol bskyed/ rlung sems drag tu dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs rnams bya/ des 'od gsal gyi rtags snang dang bde stong gi nyams rgya cher mched nas rgya 'byams su 'gro/ de'i ngang la dbyings su 'pho thub pa'ang yod/ de skabs ma 'phos kyang rung ste sngar gyi rgyun de ka bsgom/ thim rim rnams shar pa'i mgo brtsams dus nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ des nges par 'chi ba 'od gsal rang ngo 'phrod par 'gyur ba yin no// 'di skabs su spro zhing dgos na/ khams thim rim rnams dang*/ snang ba bzhi'i rnam bzhag zhib mor bshad do// dmigs bskor lnga bcu pa'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor goms stobs 'jug par bstan pa ni/ ches skal pa dman pa'am/ tshe gtugs nas nyams rtogs khyad par can tshe 'di la ma skyes kyang*/ chos 'di dang ma bral pa bzhin du dus las 'das na/ skye ba phyi ma la nges par grol ba thob ste/ rnal 'byor dbang po rnal 'byor ma thob zhes sogs kyi lung dang sbyar ro// gsum pa ni/ chos rje kun spangs chen po'i gsung gi/ dbu yi nang sa bon rang sems haṃ a hūm̐/ zla nyi nam mkha'i mdog can gtsugs gsang snying*// srog rtsol bsu skyel gcig tu bsdus byas nas// 'dun pa rtse gcig gang 'dod gnas su 'pho// zhes gsungs te/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun/ lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma yang gong du bshad pa bzhin dbu ma'i nang spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo mthur bstan/ lte ba a dmar (219)po dang*/ snying kha hūm̐ sngon po gnyis mgo gyen bstan/ spyi bo'i steng du bla ma'am yi dam bzhugs par bsam/

rlung kha sbyor zhig bzung*/ steng rlung mnan pas/ hi hūm̐ la thim/ 'og rlung 'then pas a yang hūm̐ la thim/ huṃ de yang 'dar khril li li thig le khra bo zhig tu gyur par bsam/ yang 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung sangs kyis bus pas thig le de dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ spyi gtsug nas rgyangs kyis thon/ bla ma'i thugs khar thim/ de dang 'od gsal rtags snang 'dres pa la cung zad mnyam par gzhag /de 'dra ba la lan 'ga' re song ba na/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas yi ge rnams babs te/ sngar bzhin rang gnas su gnas par bsam/ bla ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu nas rang la thim/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga yang zum par mos/ de ltar yun ring du sbyangs pas rtags 'byung zhing*/ ci snye ma byung na yar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa dang bstun drag rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba byas pas 'phral du rtags 'ong*/ ha cang drags te thal gyis dogs pa'am/ stod mtshang dang*/ mgo la zug gzer drag po 'phral du skye ba byung na/ dbu ma'i nang nas gser gyi rdo rje ljid dang ldan pa zhig thur du song*/ bshang sgo nas thon/ sa 'og thag ring por shugs dang bcas te song nas/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du gser gyi 'khor lo chen po gcig gi lte bar thams kyis zug par bsam/ de yang yang bsgoms pas sel/ 'bebs sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de yan chad 'pho ba sbyang (220)ba'i gdams ngag yin/ las la sbyar ba'i skabs ni yar 'pho ba 'ba' zhig las mar 'bebs pa mi byed/ drag rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba'ang skabs su bab na bya'o// 'di'i gdam ngag gi yi ge 'ga' zhig las a huṃ la thim/ huṃ haṃ la thim/ de thig le khra bor gyur ba 'dar khril li li 'dug /yang rlung lte bar mnan pas yig 'bru rnams sngar lugs bzhin 'khod/ de nas 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung 'bud pas hi kra dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ yig 'bru rnams mas rim gyis thim/ de thig le khra bor gyur/

spyi gtsug nas bla ma'i thugs khar 'pho zhes bshad de/ dmigs pa 'di ngos rnam pa gsal ba tsam snang ngo*// de ltar na 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ste/ dmigs bskor nga gcig pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ ci ste 'chi ba 'od gsal ngo 'phrod kyang*/ goms shugs chung zhing sgom yun thungs pas ma grol na/ bar do'i snang ba 'char bar 'gyur bas/ der lam bsgoms na grol bar 'gyur ro// de yang da lta nas 'dun pas mtshams sbyor dgos te/ nam zhig bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i skabs su tha mal gyi zhen pa dang 'grogs na 'khor ba 'khyams pas/ gnas skabs der yang 'di ltar sgom snyam du mtshams sbyar nas/ yan lag drug po gang yang rung ba bdag nyid gang la gtso bor byed pa de bsgom// bar dor 'di ltar bsgom snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang btang*/ res 'ga' ni/ 'di thams cad bar do yin par 'dug /skabs 'dir ma 'khrul bar bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags su bsten cing*/ (221)chags sdang la sogs pa'i blo spangs nas rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid bsgom/ res 'ga' na bar do'i mtshan nyid lus la grib ma med pa dang*/ nye du la sogs pas ngo mi shes pa dang*/ ya nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi'am lnga/ ma nges pa'i rnam 'gyur rnam pa drug /'gro ba'i lam bzhi la sogs pa/ bar do'i lus dang snang ba'i mtshan nyid 'di dang 'di lta bu dag yin na/ da lta de lta bu re re nas yod dam med// tshang ngam ma tshang zhes brtag cing*// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa dang*/ bden med sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas chags sdang spangs te// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid sgom mo// khyad par thun mtshams 'gro chags nyal 'dug /zas spyod lam/ gtam smra brjod/ dgra gnyen gyis 'brel pa sogs/ snod bcud kyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba'i skabs su/ yang yang dran pas zin par byas te/ 'di rnams sgom pa gal che/ de ltar nyin mo sad dus su bsgoms pas/ rmi lam du'ang phal cher 'char kyin 'dug na/

bar dor lam bsgoms pas grol bar the tshom med do// dmigs bskor nga gnyis pa'o// lnga pa ni/ mun khang gsum la rim gyis bslab/ bde sdug rkyen rnams kun la bsre// shugs chad la sogs rang sar bskyong*// longs spyod spyod lam kun la bslab// ces pa ltar te/ de yang*/ dang por mun khang dngos su rtags snang rtag tu 'ong zhing brtan por song na/ mun khang 'bring po zhes bya ba/ gos kyis mgo gtums te lus gnad sngar dang 'dra (222)ba'i steng nas bslab/ thog mar rtags snang rnams mun khang las cung mi gsal tsam 'byung*/ cung zad goms nas mun khang dang khyad med par 'char// de nas lus gnad gzhan rnams spyi dang 'dra bar bcas/ mig btsum ste/ mig 'bras gyen la bzlog pas nang du lta stangs kyi gnad ma 'khrul bar yong*/ de ltar bsgoms pas thog mar rtags snang nyung ba tsam 'byung zhing*/ gsal mi gsal la sngar dang khyad mi 'dug na/ de kha bsgom pas zhag 'ga' zhig nas rtags snang shin tu mang ba 'byung*/ yang sngar las stong gzugs mi gsal du song snyam byed na/ da dung mun khang chung ngu sgom ma ran pa yin pas/ re zhig snga ma rnams la dmigs pa drag por gtad de bsgom/ slar yang mun khang chung ngur bsgoms pas sngar bzhin gsal bar 'ong ngo*/ gzhan yang mig la dgab pa'i mun khung chung nga'i khyad par gzhan 'ga' zhig byed pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ de ltar mun khang che 'bring chung gsum la goms nas/ dang por snang ba cung zad dang bcas pa'i khang par bslab/ de nas snang ba ches gsal ba'i phyogs su'ang bslab/ de nas thun gyi skabs lta stangs kyi gnad ma 'chug par bya zhing*/ thun mtshams su lta stangs gyen thur thad ka g.yas g.yon la sogs pa ma nges pa dang*/ de bzhin du mig gdangs pa dang btsum pa dang*/ zim mer lta ba sogs lta lugs kyang ma nges pa la bslabs pas/ rim gyis thams cad du stong gzugs kyi gsal snang 'byung bar 'gyur ro// yang bde sdug mtho dman thams cad la bsre dgos te/

de yang dang por tsher ma zug pa'am/ sna rdo thug pa'am/ (223)rlung dang nyi ma dang kha char la sogs pa'i tsha grang phra mo tsam rang shugs su byung ba'am/ ched kyis kyang de dag gi gnas su song na/ tsha grang gi reg bya cung zad myong ba de la che re bltas te mi g.yo ba gsum ldan gyi ngang bskyangs/ thog ma sems 'jog stabs mi bde ba tsam 'byung na'ang*/ cung zad goms nas tsha grang du snang bde gsal char song*/ sems gtad pas de nyid ngos bzung dang bral te/ lus kyi reg bya myong tshul du mi bde yang*/ de kha'i steng du sems 'jog stabs shin tu bde ba zhig 'byung*/ da dung de'i rang ngo la bltas te bsgoms pas tsha grang du snang ba de snang la ngos bzung med par nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du/ bkres skom dang ngal dub la sogs pa la yang sbyar bas mthar na tsha sdug bsngal chen po thog tu bab kyang lam du longs pa zhig 'ong*/ de bzhin du/ gtam mi snyan pa rang gi yid la mi 'thad pa'i tshig dag thos pas/ sems mi bde kar gyis byung ba'i dus kyang*/ mi bde ba dang tshig spyi de la cher gyis bltas te/ btsal na ngos bzung med pa de ngos zin par byas nas mi g.yo gsum ldan bskyang ngo*// de bzhin du/ yid skyo ba dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ 'jig pa dang*/ spro ba dang*/ khengs pa dang*/ chags pa dang*/ sdang pa dang*/ ser sna dang*/ phrag dog sogs gang byung thams cad la de bzhin bskyang pas rang sangs su 'gro ba yin no// gzhan yang*/ lam du phyin pa'i ngal dub dang*/ khur chen po 'khur ba dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ mdo 'don dang*/ gsung sgrog sogs 'jur po byas pa dang*/ (224)brtsis dang*/ mno bsam dang*/ lta rtog 'jur po sogs rjes su'ang sngar gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya rtsol drag po des rnam rtog gi shugs chang yod pas de dus rig pa lta shes tsam byas nas/ yid mi g.yo bar bzhag pa nyid kyis rig pa gsal stong mtha' dbus med par 'char ro// gzhan yang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yid du 'ong ba dang phrad pa'i tshe dga' lhang ste yong ba dang*/

gzugs sogs mi sdug pa gnod pa can dang phrad pa'i tshe/ zur rngur lhang ste byang ba kun la'ang gang byung de la sems gtad de/ sngar bzhin mi g.yo gsum ldan bskyang*// gzhan yang mdo 'don sngags bzlas phyag dang bskor ba snying rje nges 'byung sogs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba rnams dang*/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam kun tu/ 'phral 'phral 'dun pas sleb par byas te/ gang shar de la bzo med du bskyangs pas rang grol du 'gyur ba'i gnad zin par bya'o// 'di dag shin tu gal che yang*/ dmigs thun grangs nges su bcad pa med pas ci bde bar bya'o// dmigs bskor nga gsum la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa sa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ de ltar sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs/ sor sdud kyis dbu ma'i lam cung zad dag /sems gnas pa la rang dbang thob pa'i// rnam rtog gi bar chod mi 'byung zhing*/ 'od gsal rtags bcu thog mar bsgrubs/ bsam gtan gyis dbu ma'i lam shin tu sbyangs shing*/ rang sems/ stong gzugs/ las snang dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin (225)dbyer med spros bral du shes/ rtags bcu brtan cing sngar bas kyang ches khyad par du song*/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag gis yan lag 'di nyid mthar phyin na/ sbyor lam drod kyi dang po la slebs pa yin la/ bskyed rim ma brtan par 'di rnams bsgoms nas mthar phyin pa yin na/ sngags kyi tshogs lam chen po tsam yin no// de nas srog rtsol gyi yan lag gis rlung bcu dbu mar thim pas/ gzung 'dzin tha dad par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mngon 'gyur ba 'gag cing*/ phyi nang gi 'byung ba la ci rigs par dbang thob pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes sogs nus pa'ang cung zad rnyed pa dang*/ gtum mo cung zad 'bar bas bde stong gi nyams gsal por shar ba yin te/ sngar bskyed rim brtan rung ma brtan rung*/ drod chung 'bring man chad yan lag 'dis thob par 'gyur ro// 'dzin pa'i yan lag gis rlung mtha' dag dbu ma'i thig le rnams la thim pas gtum mo rang 'bar rgyun mi 'chad cing*/

nus pa dang yon tan sngar bas bcu 'gyur nas brgya 'gyur gyi bar du 'phel/ drod chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes nas rtse mo la mtshams sbyor bas 'gyur/ rjes dran gyis ye shes kyi sku chung ngu thob cing*/ gtum mo 'bar ba lhag par stobs su gyur pas zhu bde 'dzag med kyi dga' bzhi rdzogs par 'dren/ nyon mongs rags pa mngon 'gyur ba spong*/ rtse mo mthar phyin pa'i bar du'o// ting nge 'dzin ni bzod pa dang*/ chos mchog ste/ las rlung 'gags shing thig le la brtan pa sogs 'khor ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dngos su spong bar byed pa'i lam ste/ gsang (226)gnas kyi 'khor lo'i phyed mi 'gyur ba'i byang sems kyis gang bas sa dang po'o// phyed phyi ma gang bas sa gnyis pa/ zhes sogs 'khor lo gzhan lnga la'ang sbyar bas/ gtsug tor gyi phyed phyi ma gang ste/ gtsug tor yang hril gyis brtan pas sa bcu gnyis pa'o// de'i skad cig gnyis par gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub ces bya ste/ de yang ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bcu gnyis pa'i skad cig ma tha ma der yang dag pa 'phags pa'i mthong lam rgyud la skyes nas/ 'khor ba'i lus ngag yid dang chags rtog rnams spangs zin/ de'i rjes kyi skad cig la gnyis su med pa ste/ zung 'jug gi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje mngon du byed/ de nas kun tu 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis thob/ gnas la sogs pa'am rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis sam bcu cig rim gyis bgrod par 'gyur te/ mthar gyis 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug zung du 'jug pa'i ngo bo// yon tan dang*/ ye shes rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa/ phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid can rgyun mi 'chad pa thob par 'gyur te/ skal pa dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus can gyis ma nor ba'i lam mchog 'di la 'bad na tshe 'di nyid kyis khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa nyid do// 'di dag rgyas par gzhan du bshad par bya'o// gsum pa rnal 'byor mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'i yan lag ni/

lam gyi gegs sel bogs 'don dang (227)rnal 'byor gyi rgyan mi nyams shing bsrung ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ gzhan du shes par bya la/ gnyis pa la/ bka' rgya bzhi yi rgyas btab pa'i yan lag /bar chad spang ba'i yan lag /dam tshig bsrung ba'i yan lag /spyod pa skyong ba'i yan lag ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ snod min la gsang bar gdams pa ste/ bka' rgyas gdab bar bya ba bzhi ni/ sngon 'gro'i gdams ngag /dngos gzhi'i gdams ngag /rang gi nyams myong*/ bla mas ji ltar ngo sprod pa ste bzhi 'am/ gdams ngag ji ltar phog pa/ nyams myong ji ltar skyes pa/ ngo bo ji ltar sprod pa/ gegs sel bogs 'don ji ltar byed pa ste bzhi yin zhes kyang kha cig 'chad de/ don gcig tu 'bab pa'i phyir gnyis ka'ang mi 'gal lo// skabs 'dir bka' rgyas gdab par bya'o// gnyis pa la// lam bzang 'phrog pa'i chom rkun spang ba/ lam bzang 'dod pa'i rgyu g.yo can gyi ston pa spang ba lam bzang la bar du gcod pa'i bdud ngo shes par bya ba/ lam zab mo bsrung zhing sbed par gdams pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dri med 'od las/ lam bzang rin chen 'di ni bag med pa'i// sems can gzhan pa rnams la byin pa na// rang khyim dgon pa dag tu rab bzhags te// yul ngan chom kun rnams kyis 'phrog par byed// the tshom 'gyod pa dag dang nyid dang ni// le lo rgod pa'i chom rkun rnams kyis kyang*// gnyen 'dun thib ba'i nang du ra bzhugs te/ rin po che ni rtag tu 'phrog par byed// shin tu bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs dang*// (228)longs spyod du ma'i chom rkun rnams kyis kyang*// brtson 'grus ldan du zin kyang bag med cing*// brgyal bar gyur pa nyid la 'phrog par byed// ces gsungs te/ rang yul dang rang khyim la zhen pa dang*/ dgra gnyen gyi chags sdang dang*/ gnyid sogs sgrib pa lnga'i dbang du gtong ba dang*/ longs spyod sna tshogs kyis g.yengs ba dang*/

yul lnga la sred pa'i khong skan can rnams la/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po dang por mi skye zhing*/ lan gcig skyes kyang nyams par 'gyur bas de dag gi dbang du mi gtong*/ gnyis pa ni// rang nyid yongs su rtog pa po min phyir// rin thang chen por 'gyur ram shes chen pa// g.yo can gzhan la ston te mi 'gyur zhes// de yi tshig gis rin chen 'dor bar byed// gang dag rin chen bzang po rig pa rnams// rin chen chen po yongs su rtog tu gzhug /de dag rnams kyis rnam dag tshig gi bzhi// rang gi yid phren rnam par shes par bya// zhes gsungs te/ lam 'di nyid kyi nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa ma gtogs/ gzhan la rang gi nyams rtogs rnams shin tu gsang zhing dgos gcod mi 'dri ba'o// gsum pa ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*// pha dang ma dang bu mo srin mo dang*// bu dang spun zla 'dod pa'i chung ma yi// gzugs rnams kyis ni bdud rnams gegs byed do// ces te/ bar chad ngo shes nas de'i dbang du mi gtong ba'o// bzhi pa ni// de phyir bla ma dam pas gnang ba yi// lam bzang rin po che ni slob ma yis// chom rkun rtsa lag yongs su spangs byas te// 'bad pas shin tu legs par sba bar bya// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa dam tshig dang sdom pa'i yan (229)lag ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi bsrung zhing*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga la gnas pa dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig gsang ste bsten pa dang*/ lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis sgom zhing*/ nyams myong gi mi mthun phyogs rnams spangs/ mthun rkyen rnams bsgrub pa ste/ dam tshig gi rnam bzhag rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bshad do// bzhi pa spyod pa bskyong ba'i yan lag ni/ mi dge ba bcu spangs// dge ba bcu la gnas/ chos la dad pa brtan pos las 'bras la blang dor phyin ci ma log par spyod cing*/

rang gis ji ltar blangs pa'i bslab pa rnams la nan tan snying por bsgrub/ gang zag la dad pas sangs rgyas byang sems sogs 'phags pa rnams dang*/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la mos gus kyi sgo nas skyabs su
